personality_one_liner: A sharp, live operational command center designed for fast scanning, immediate data hierarchy, and sweat-proof readability.

spacing.rule: Use tight, grid-like spacing to maximize information density without feeling cluttered. Keep a mechanical rhythm using dividers instead of padding bloat.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevation instead of glass, ensuring max readability on dense data screens.
dont's: Never use blur or glassmorphism on this app. It clashes with the sharp, utility-first personality.

screens.name: Time Entry (Home)
screens.purpose: Log daily hours efficiently with real-time conversion feedback.

states.empty: N/A for form, but missing selected employee shows 'Select Employee to Start' illustration.
states.error: Red inline error below failed time inputs + retry button.

screens.layout: Header: Employee dropdown selector + Light/Dark mode toggle. Below Header: Horizontal scrolling 7-day calendar strip. Hero Section: A large, stacked dual metric display (Standard hours in IBM Plex Sans, Decimal output aggressively highlighted in Barlow Condensed). Form Area: Single column, labels above inputs. Row 1: Start Time. Row 2: Break Time List (dynamically add multiple break start/end pairs). Row 3: End Time. Action: Sticky 'Save Entry' button anchored at the safe-area bottom over the scrolling content.

screens.name: Summary & Export
screens.purpose: Review logged days for the month and generate admin reports.

states.loading: Skeleton rows reflecting the table structure.
states.empty: Digital clock minimalist image, 'No entries found for this month.', and CTA to 'Log Hours'.

screens.layout: Top: Month selector. Content: Flat list of days grouped by week with thick dividers between weeks. Each row displays the Date, Standard Time, and prominent Decimal Time on the right edge. Bottom: Two sticky buttons side-by-side or stacked ('Export PDF' and 'Export CSV').

screens.name: Employees
screens.purpose: Manage the list of employees for the time tracker.

states.empty: Monochrome office desk image, 'No employees added.', CTA 'Add Employee'.
states.error: Toast or inline message 'Failed to save employee'.

screens.layout: Simple list of employees displaying name and total hours logged this month. Floating Action Button (FAB) or sticky bottom button to 'Add Employee'.

empty_summary.alt: Minimalist digital clock in the dark

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the '7 Dark-First Utility DARK' personality. The app should feel like an active command-center. Rely on hard dividers and background tonality (surfaceSecondary) to separate sections, not shadows or blur.
BANNED: Any shade of blue, purple, or indigo. Stick strictly to the warm amber/rust brand color against the obsidian dark surfaces.
Ensure 'Barlow Condensed' is heavily used for the live numbers (the standard vs decimal output) to create aggressive, clear numeric hierarchy.
Form design: Implement a single-column flow with labels directly above the inputs. Ensure the 'Add Break' function dynamically injects a Start/End time pair.
Sticky Actions: The 'Save Entry' CTA must be locked above the bottom safe area (with safe-area clearance) using absolute positioning so the form scrolls behind it.
Export Requirements: Integrate `expo-print` and `expo-file-system` to handle CSV and PDF local generation.

The default theme MUST be Dark per the user request, but implement a context toggle for Light Mode. For Light Mode tokens: surface: #FAFAFA, surfaceSecondary: #FFFFFF, surfaceTertiary: #F0F0F0, border: #E0E0E0, onSurface: #111111. Keep the same Amber brand color.
Image Scrim Rule: Any text sitting over the Unsplash empty state images must use a vertical 3-stop linear-gradient (transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse) to ensure text contrast.
Haptics: Provide tactile feedback (haptics) on timer entries, saving forms, and switching tabs to emphasize the 'machine-fast' feel of the app.
